That's brilliant. You're the first guy to ever wonder this. We did not descend from monkeys. Monkeys and we have a common ancestor. So you may have seen this picture, this famous arrangement. As we say, the family tree of hominids, like you and me, and even my old boss, it's not just a straight line of one organism leading to another, it's a bush, as we say.
